elsewhere.note: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel.…
For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.
